description: Retrieve the output for a completed Freebeat task. Only call after get_task_status returns completed. Current supported completed MV and effect results return result.video_url and result.cover_url. If the task is still pending or running, this tool returns TASK_NOT_COMPLETED. If the task failed, this tool surfaces the backend failure.

task_id.description: Task ID returned by a generation tool

name: get_task_result

message.description: A human-readable summary of the completed task result.

result.description: The structured output payload for the completed task. Current supported MV and effect tasks return video_url and cover_url.

cover_url.description: The cover image URL for the generated video.

status.description: The current backend result-query status, for example pending, running, completed, failed, or legacy uppercase variants.

success.description: Whether the task result was retrieved successfully.

task_type.description: The task category returned by Freebeat.
